summary: Neuronetics, Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a firm-commitment underwritten follow-on offering of 18,750,000 shares of common stock at $1.60 per share, for gross proceeds of $30.0 million. The deal prices at a discount to the $2.01 last reported sale on November 10, 2026. Underwriting discounts are $0.0960 per share ($1.8 million), leaving $28.2 million before expenses. William Blair leads, with BTIG and Canaccord Genuity as bookrunners. A 2,812,500-share, 30-day greenshoe is granted, and certain directors indicated non-binding interest. This is an ordinary shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch dilution and pricing pressure.
